WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry,
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s
    ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
),
project_excess AS (
  SELECT
    arcregistry,
    fundflux,
    ratio,
    ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS excess
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio, excess
FROM project_excess
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
